description: 目标语义部件覆盖率、独立可编辑性

description: 目标表面距离、轮廓差异、支撑与穿透
与参考目标计算采样表面距离，按目标尺寸归一化；另测凹腔/空隙、厚度及相接关系，AABB 只能粗筛。隐藏细节不做精确形状要求。

description: 非目标几何、变换、材质、纹理、灯光、主相机保持率

description: 主视角目标轮廓、材质与阴影；非目标像素漂移
从提交 scene.blend 重渲染，分目标、接触阴影和其余区域报告。图像分数与几何分数分开；目标遮挡和阴影的合理变化不应算非目标编辑。

核对备用相机局部 X 平移 0.30 m，旋转和镜头不变；禁用按相机切换目标形状的做法。备用图只作结构诊断，不匹配历史作者备用图。

active_checks.source: Render output/main.png from the supplied main camera, preserving the scene's Cycles, resolution, exposure and color-management settings. Render output/alternate.png from a second camera translated 0.30 m to the right along the main camera's local X axis, with the same rotation and lens. Keep both cameras in output/scene.blend. Both renders must come from the same edited scene. The alternate view is a structural check and has no supplied target image.

Start from input/initial.blend. Use the existing geometry as the scale and placement context, and use the single supplied image as the appearance reference. Keep all existing non-target geometry, world transforms, materials, textures, lights and camera settings unchanged. Add independently editable three-dimensional geometry for the missing object; do not substitute an image plane or a projection of the full reference photograph. Small hidden details may be completed plausibly rather than copied from an unavailable original model. Use metres and Z up, and pack any new texture dependencies into the scene.

score_aggregation_note:
## 当前复评口径：v8 / Strict fidelity review

仅复评原作品，未改动原生成题面。逐题原图/文本特征；主视图必查，跨视图项必须核对所有公开原图和候选双视图。
每项列出达成、差异和严重度后评0–4级；主要缺陷最多2级，主体错误/缺失0级，不能因制作精致掩盖不忠于参考。
保持原总权重及自动/物理测量：Brief VLM60/测量30/物理10；Edit 数值20/目标30/保持20/物理10/VLM20；Reference 图像50/定位20/物理10/VLM20。
定位沿用原冻结参考框及公式，重新独立识别候选框。禁止任意配准。未展示仅扣对应项；技术失败不补零。
机器草案和裁判尚待人工校准，不声称人工认证。详见 harness/vlm_spec.json。
